Readback decision: READY

`95b83e71ee9a37041b9918b5e8b797eebabf69c9`. The earlier HOLD reflected a cold-session lookup that

same-SHA readback now finds the Episode: state `REOPENED`, former head
`fbeb8958f4405688b13f37dbdec330157a660ab0`, current head
`95b83e71ee9a37041b9918b5e8b797eebabf69c9`, acceptance `DIRECT_BASIS` at commit `95b83e7` (event 8;
approval event 7), with zero open questions. The old Episode is a historical advisory `DELIVER`
conclusion recorded on revision 1 / head `fbeb8958`; it is not the current acceptance record. Its
`REOPENED` state records that the project later advanced to `95b83e7`, not that the accepted
revision was invalidated.

The current accepted version is `95b83e7`. Verification record
`journal:pje-d0c977aae7bb8bfeca9159f76e14a7d1` is present as a `REFERENCE_NOTE` from the independent
Fleet release verifier. It reviewed candidate `95b83e7` and records accepted project version
`95b83e7`, including the before/after observation that zero or omitted limits returned no frames
before the change and three readings in source order in the accepted tree. The verification is on the
same SHA as the current acceptance, so it is current for this handover rather than a stale reference.
The note records no separate contributor decision, and this review does not turn it into one.
